question: Which of following pairs belongs to homologous series of alkenes?
solution:
The correct answer is __**C₃H₆ and C₄H₈.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Alkenes are hydrocarbons that contain at least one carbon-carbon double bond (C=C) and have the general formula CₙH₂ₙ.
 
• The pair C₃H₆ (propylene) and C₄H₈ (butene) belong to the homologous series of alkenes, which differ by a CH2 unit.
 
• In homologous series, compounds have similar chemical properties and a gradual change in physical properties.
 
• Each successive member of an alkene series increases by one carbon atom and two hydrogen atoms (CH₂ group).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Homologous Series:**

 
 
• A series of compounds with the same functional group and similar chemical properties, where each successive member differs by a CH₂ unit.
 
• Examples include alkanes (CₙH₂ₙ₊₂), alkenes (CₙH₂ₙ), and alkynes (CₙH₂ₙ₋₂).
 
 
 
• **Functional Group:**
 
 
• A group of atoms responsible for the characteristic reactions of a particular compound.
 
• In alkenes, the functional group is the carbon-carbon double bond (C=C).
 
 
 
• **Isomerism in Alkenes:**
 
 
• Alkenes can exhibit structural isomerism and geometrical (cis-trans) isomerism.
 
• Isomers have the same molecular formula but different structures or spatial arrangements.
 
 
 
• **Chemical Properties of Alkenes:**
 
 
• Alkenes typically undergo addition reactions, such as hydrogenation, halogenation, and hydrohalogenation.
 
• They are also known for polymerization reactions, forming long-chain polymers.
